routerReasons.hoverASegmentForItsCount: Hover a segment for its count and share of that model
routerReasons.whyAutoServedEachModelOver: Why Auto served each model over the selected range. Each bar is one model: its length is that model's share of all routed usage under the intent and agent type filters above, and its segments are the router's reasons for picking it. The model filter does not apply here because every model is already a row. Unattributed means no reason was recorded for those messages (sessions from before the record existed, or resumed after a restart).

routerTransparency.intentBreakdownAndFilteringRequireAdvanc: Intent breakdown and filtering require Advanced Analytics.

routerUsageMix.dailyShareOfSuccessfulManagedAuto: Daily share of successful managed Auto and Auto Fast usage, measured as billed messages or FSC. The filters above narrow the routed population before each day is normalized to 100%.

spendBreakdown.shareOfFscByEachSessions: Share of FSC by each session's automatically classified primary intent. Sessions without a classification are excluded, so shares describe classified spend only.

company.description: Daily FSC spend over the selected date range. Overall shows the unsplit daily total; By Model and By User stack the top 7 by FSC with everything else folded into Others. By Source splits the product source behind each call (managed chat, BYOK, Compute, Prem, and Advanced Analytics, which combines live and backfill Local Signals), where FSC accrues to Factory-managed inference and so dominates by design, and By Access Type splits Human (interactive) vs API (programmatic) spend.
company.title: Spend Over Time

enterprise.description: Daily or monthly FSC spend across your root organization and its sub-organizations over the selected date range; a month still in progress counts through today. Overall shows the unsplit total; By Organization, By Model, and By User stack the top 7 by FSC with everything else folded into Others. By User Type splits human users from service accounts, By Source splits the product source behind each call, and By Access Type splits Human (interactive) vs API (programmatic) spend.

personal.description: Your daily FSC over the selected date range. Overall shows your unsplit daily total; By Model stacks your top 7 models by FSC with everything else folded into Others. The model split excludes models Factory runs under the hood (e.g. session-title generation), so it can total slightly less than Overall.
personal.title: Usage Over Time

topUsers.title: Top Users by Spend
topUsers.description: Top 20 users by total FSC over the selected date range, with each user's share of company FSC, billed sessions, and share of all company sessions.
topUsers.enterpriseDescription: Every user with usage over the selected date range across your root organization and its sub-organizations, ranked by total FSC, with the organizations their spend landed in, each user's share of the combined FSC, billed sessions, and share of all sessions. FSC / Month is the user's average FSC per active month, over the complete calendar months in the range; the month in progress is left out.
